description: Formula agent: Kelly fraction, half Kelly, expectancy and the position size for a stop-loss, capped at a maximum risk per trade. Tells you when there is no edge. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
